page.notes: Corrected to the printed text where the scan is clear: long s rendered as plain s throughout (e.g. "diversissimæ", "ipsos", "siquidem", "insumit"). Uncertain readings: "faciliùs"/"reddituros" line break near "reddituAfter" is a transcription error on my part and should be checked; the printed word is "reddituiros" or "redditurós" as set on the line. "Zabarella,libro" has no space after the comma as printed. "præterii-mus" is hyphenated at the line end as printed.
